title: squalify must describe files with repeated header and data blocks
lead: Detects multi-table files: two or more data runs of the same width, each at least 5 records long. A later run starts a new block when one of its first 5 records exactly repeats block 0's header (records before it become the block's annotation, the gap its preamble), or when its first record is a header that fails at least half the typed columns and the gap before it holds a non-data line (comment, key=value, one-field line). Each block is a `block` region with `index` (no label) holding its own preamble, annotation, header and data. The file is read once: the leading blocks that share block 0's header are profiled together; at the first block with a different header profiling stops and the issue `heterogeneousBlocks` lists the remaining blocks' header lines. `fingerprint.version` is 2.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** blocks with different delimiters; nested tables.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner decision (2026-10-13): repeated blocks are split out of sq-04 into their own item. Lab exports often repeat a header and table per site, temperature or sweep.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/squalify/Delimited/BlockDetector.cs`: works on sq-04's RLE.
- `DelimitedProfiler`: aggregates fields across blocks when the headers are identical.
- Layout fingerprint: adds `blocks: true` when there is more than one block. The block count is excluded, so 3 blocks and 5 blocks give the same fingerprint.
- `dialect.blocks` gives the count.
- `docs/descriptor.md`: the `block` region with `index` and `label`. `docs/how-it-works.md` section 4.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `Blocks_IdenticalHeaders_FieldsAggregated`.
2. `Blocks_Heterogeneous_FirstProfiled_Issue`.
3. `Blocks_SingleTable_GoldensUnchanged`: every sq-04 and sq-05 golden stays byte-identical.
4. `Blocks_Fingerprint_BlockCountExcluded`.
5. A golden for `delimited/per-site-blocks.csv`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests.
2. Implement the detector, then the wiring.
3. Mutation check: change the minimum run length from 5 to 1, and tests 1 and 3 must change.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet format squalify.sln --verify-no-changes`
- If this slice changed architecture (the pipeline, an interface, a descriptor section or a determinism rule), `docs/how-it-works.md` and its diagrams are updated and `./scripts/render-docs.sh` has been re-run. The architect confirms there is no drift.
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/sq-13` on branch `sq-13`. No agent commits. After the gate returns `VERDICT: PASS`, the orchestrator commits `sq-13: repeated blocks` when the owner approves.
